name: Voxel-based Void Ratio Computation
aliases: Particle Voxelization, Void Ratio Field Computation
definition: A method to compute a void ratio field from a legacy ASCII VTK particle point cloud by binning particle centers into cubic voxels, computing one void ratio per occupied voxel, and assigning that value to all particles in the voxel.
summary: Voxel-based Void Ratio Computation calculates void ratios by binning particles into voxels and using numerical integration to account for partial sphere volumes at boundaries.
